uberAvailabilitySource.label: UCLA Transportation — Ride-Hailing at UCLA
uberAvailabilitySource.notes: UCLA states that it partnered with Uber for campus pickup zones active 24 hours a day, seven days a week. This verifies campus service availability, not wait-time estimates or mobility scores.

uberAvailabilitySource.label: Colgate University — Reunion transportation guidance
uberAvailabilitySource.notes: Colgate explicitly says Uber/Lyft are not reliable in Hamilton and that advance transportation reservations are required to guarantee availability. This supports a Limited/Unreliable qualitative classification, but does not verify the existing 35/95-minute wait estimates or Mobility Score. Uber's official Hamilton page confirms requests are supported while warning pickup times may be longer than in larger cities.
